---
title: Cache Directory
description: Print the on-disk path to the per-repo cache or the global cache root
---

`ghqc cache dir` prints the cache directory for the current repo (default) or the cache root (`--global`). Useful for piping into other tools.

```bash
ghqc cache dir [--global]
```

Aliases: `ghqc cache directory`.

## Examples

```bash
# Per-repo cache directory
ghqc cache dir
# /home/user/.cache/ghqc/A2-ai/ghqctoolkit

# Cache root
ghqc cache dir --global
# /home/user/.cache/ghqc

# Pipe into other tools
du -sh "$(ghqc cache dir)"
```

## Options

| Flag | Description |
|---|---|
| `--global` | Print the cache root rather than the per-repo subdirectory. |

## Notes

- When run outside a git repository, the per-repo form errors; pass `--global` instead.
